normative_extracts.quote: Cascade layers are sorted by order of appearance, with unlayered author styles having higher priority than any named layer.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Layer order overrides selector specificity for normal declarations.

production_failures.symptom: !important rule in a lower layer overrides a higher layer
production_failures.root_cause: The specification reverses layer order for !important declarations.
production_failures.mitigation: Avoid !important in base layers or document it explicitly as an invariant.
Wrap third-party imports in a dedicated low-priority layer.
